options.name: accelerator
options.description: Driver accelerator, 1 - 1h, 2 - 2h, 3 - 3h. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is PMC.

options.name: access
options.description: Access Policy, 1 - Read Write, 2 - Read Only, 3 - Blocked. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI.

options.name: cache
options.description: Drive Cache, 1 - Unchanged, 2 - Enabled,3 - Disabled. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI.

options.name: ctrl_id
options.description: Raid controller ID. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI,PMC or MV.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: info
options.description: Show controller and physical drive info.

options.name: init
options.description: Init State, 1 - No Init, 2 - Quick Init, 3 - Full Init. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI.

options.name: io
options.description: IO Policy, 1 - Direct IO, 2 - Cached IO. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI.

options.name: level
options.description: RAID Level, 0 - RAID0, 1 - RAID1, 5 - RAID5, 6 - RAID6, 10 - RAID10. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI or PMC.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: r
options.description: Read Policy, 1 - Read Ahead, 2 - No Read Ahead. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI.

options.name: select
options.description: Select Size, from 1 to 100. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI.

options.name: size
options.description: Strip Size, 0 - 32k, 1 - 64k, 2 - 128k, 3 - 256k, 4 - 512k, 5 - 1024k. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI,PMC or MV. When the controller type is MV,size is [0, 1]. When the controller type is LSI or PMC,size is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].

options.name: slot
options.description: Slot Num,input multiple slotNumber like 0,1,2.... Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI or PMC.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.

options.name: vname
options.description: Virtual drive name. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is PMC or server model is M7. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is MV.

options.name: w
options.description: Write Policy, 1 - Write Through, 2 - Write Back, 3 - Write caching ok if bad BBU. Required when I(Info=None) and controller type is LSI.
